page.notes: Woodcut in the middle: a tree with a banner on its trunk bearing a short inscription that I cannot read reliably, and a standing figure in armour at the right with a dog or animal at the foot; not transcribed. Handwritten annotations are not printed text and are left out: "Collegij Societ. Bibl." at the upper left, and "Romani Iesu secept." at the upper right. Library stamps (oval "BIBLIOTECA NAZ... ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE" and a round seal at the right) are left out. The imprint year is printed "cIↄ Iↄ c xlix", transcribed as MDCXLIX. The last line "n. 4" is read as the gathering mark "a 4" and is uncertain; the signature is marked accordingly in the signature element, and the line in main_text carries it as well for the reader's check. The page is a title page, so no running head, page number or catchword is printed.
